LanguageData.hana.label: Rabbit beast ear Hana
LanguageData.hana.description:
She was given the false information that Siro and Kon were caught in a colony. She got on board alone. She is very powerful, but new to battle and unfamiliar with battle. She came to help because she was a subordinate (appointed without permission) She heard that her important friend was caught and could not stand even when standing.
In short she is Tsundere.
She is the daughter of a very wealthy merchant. It seems that when a trader comes, they are trading It will bless you with silver on a regular basis.
